functions.name: c00_simple_if
functions.source: static boolean c00_simple_if(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a) return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: One top-level if adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c01_nested_if
functions.source: static boolean c01_nested_if(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a) { if (b) return true; } return false; }
functions.derivation: The outer if adds 1; the nested if adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c02_triple_nested_if
functions.source: static boolean c02_triple_nested_if(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a) { if (b) { if (c) return true; } } return false; }
functions.derivation: Three nested ifs add 1, 2, and 3 respectively.

functions.name: c03_if_else
functions.source: static boolean c03_if_else(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a) return true; else return false; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if and its else each add one; else is hybrid.

functions.name: c04_if_elif_else
functions.source: static boolean c04_if_elif_else(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a) return true; else if (b) return false; else return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if, else-if, and else each add one; else-if is hybrid.

functions.name: c05_three_way_chain
functions.source: static boolean c05_three_way_chain(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a) return true; else if (b) return false; else if (c) return true; else return false; return false; }
functions.derivation: One if, two else-if branches, and one else add four total.

functions.name: c06_and_sequence
functions.source: static boolean c06_and_sequence(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a && b) return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1 and the same-operator && sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c07_or_sequence
functions.source: static boolean c07_or_sequence(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a || b) return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1 and the same-operator || sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c08_mixed_boolean
functions.source: static boolean c08_mixed_boolean(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a && b || c && d) return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; &&, ||, && form three logical sequences, adding 3.

functions.name: c09_assigned_boolean
functions.source: static boolean c09_assigned_boolean(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { boolean value = a && b; return value; return false; }
functions.derivation: A binary logical sequence in an assignment adds one fundamental increment.

functions.name: c10_while_loop
functions.source: static boolean c10_while_loop(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { while (a) { a = false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: One top-level while adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c11_for_loop
functions.source: static boolean c11_for_loop(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { } return false; }
functions.derivation: One top-level loop adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c12_if_with_loop
functions.source: static boolean c12_if_with_loop(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a) { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { } } return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; the loop nested inside it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c13_nested_loops
functions.source: static boolean c13_nested_loops(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { while (a) { break; } } return false; }
functions.derivation: The outer loop adds 1; the inner loop adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c14_switch_or_match
functions.source: static boolean c14_switch_or_match(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { switch (a ? 1 : 0) { case 1: return true; default: return false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: The switch adds 1 and makes its contents nested; the conditional selector inside the switch adds 1 + 1 nesting, so 3 (SonarJava CognitiveComplexityVisitor.visitSwitchStatement increases nesting before scanning the selector; white paper B2/B3).

functions.name: c15_switch_nested_if
functions.source: static boolean c15_switch_nested_if(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { switch (a ? 1 : 0) { case 1: if (b) return true; break; default: return false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: The switch adds 1; the conditional selector inside it adds 1 + 1 nesting (3 so far); the if in a case adds 1 + 1 switch nesting, so 5.

functions.name: c16_try_one_catch
functions.source: static boolean c16_try_one_catch(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { try { if (a) return true; } catch (Exception error) { return false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: Try is ignored; the if adds 1 and each catch adds 1.

functions.name: c17_try_two_catches
functions.source: static boolean c17_try_two_catches(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { try { if (a) return true; } catch (IllegalArgumentException error) { return false; } catch (Exception other) { return true; } return false; }
functions.derivation: Try is ignored; the if adds 1 and each of two catch clauses adds 1.

functions.name: c18_recursive_call
functions.source: static boolean c18_recursive_call(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a) return true; return c18_recursive_call(b, a, c, d); return false; }
functions.derivation: The base-case if adds 1; one direct recursive call adds 1 fundamental recursion increment.

functions.name: c19_conditional_expression
functions.source: static boolean c19_conditional_expression(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { return a ? true : false; return false; }
functions.derivation: One ternary/conditional expression adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c20_nested_conditionals
functions.source: static boolean c20_nested_conditionals(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { return a ? true : (b ? false : true); return false; }
functions.derivation: The outer conditional adds 1; its nested conditional adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c21_lambda_decision
functions.source: static boolean c21_lambda_decision(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { return java.util.List.of(a).stream().anyMatch(value -> { if (value) return true; return false; }); return false; }
functions.derivation: The lambda adds no structural point but raises nesting; its if adds 1 + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c22_if_lambda_decision
functions.source: static boolean c22_if_lambda_decision(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a) return java.util.List.of(b).stream().anyMatch(value -> { if (value) return true; return false; }); return false; }
functions.derivation: Outer if adds 1; lambda if adds 1 + 2 nesting levels (outer if and lambda).

functions.name: c23_nested_callable
functions.source: static boolean c23_nested_callable(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { java.util.function.BooleanSupplier inner = () -> { if (a) return true; return false; }; return inner.getAsBoolean(); return false; }
functions.derivation: Nested callable adds no structural point but one nesting level to its if (1 + 1).

functions.name: c24_do_while
functions.source: static boolean c24_do_while(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { do { a = !a; } while (b); return false; }
functions.derivation: One top-level do-while loop adds one structural increment; its body has no nested flow break.

functions.name: c25_labeled_jump
functions.source: static boolean c25_labeled_jump(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { outer: while (a) { break outer; } return false; }
functions.derivation: One loop adds 1; the labeled jump adds one fundamental increment.

functions.name: c26_null_shortcut
functions.source: static boolean c26_null_shortcut(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { return a && (b || c); }
functions.derivation: The return expression contains one && sequence and one || sequence, for two fundamental increments.

functions.name: c27_language_idiom
functions.source: static boolean c27_language_idiom(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { outer: while (a) { while (b) { break outer; } } return false; }
functions.derivation: The outer loop adds 1, the nested loop adds 1 + 1 nesting, and the labeled break adds 1, totaling 4.

functions.name: c28_loop_if_boolean
functions.source: static boolean c28_loop_if_boolean(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { if (a && b) return true; } return false; }
functions.derivation: Loop adds 1; nested if adds 1 + 1 nesting; its && sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c29_else_loop
functions.source: static boolean c29_else_loop(boolean a, boolean b, boolean c, boolean d) { if (a) return true; else { while (b) { break; } } return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; its else adds 1. The loop in the else body is at nesting level 1, so it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting, totaling 4.
